newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds set to go lower, head for 102.59.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds set to go lower, head for 102.59.

text.p: LIFFE September Bund futures will look for a pull back on Thursday and slip towards key support at 102.59, but further out while above that level the outlook is still positive, technical analysts said.
"Bunds are corrective and are going to test back to 102.59," said Charles Diebel, senior fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London.
"Momentum studies are confirming the downside, but longer term while 102.59 holds then the bias is still to the upside and a return to 103.15."
At 0709 GMT September Bund futures were at 102.72 down 0.14.
But Diebel said if the contract broke to the upside through intra day highs around 102.94, the bearish outlook would be negated.
Michael Mueller, technical anlayst at Landesgirokasse in Stuttgart noted similar levels for Bunds for this session.

"We expect 102.58 support to be tested and if it holds we should see a rise back to 103.15," he said, adding that there would also be some resistance along the way at 102.93, the high so far on Thursday.
At the short end, December Euromarks were at 96.75, down three basis points from Wednesday's close.
